test_title: PYST 03: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Two pipes, A and B, can fill a tank of 7800 litres in 12 hours and 10 hours, respectively. If they are opened together, how many hours will they take to fill an empty tank of 8800 litres?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A can fill 7800 litres in 12 hours

Pipe B can fill 7800 litres in 10 hours

Total tank capacity to be filled = 8800 litres

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Volume ÷ Time

Time taken together = Total volume ÷ (Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B)

**Calculations:**

⇒ A’s efficiency = 7800 ÷ 12 = 650 litres/hour

⇒ B’s efficiency = 7800 ÷ 10 = 780 litres/hour

⇒ Total efficiency = 650 + 780 = 1430 litres/hour

⇒ Time to fill 8800 litres = 8800 ÷ 1430

⇒ Time = (8800)/(1430) = (880)/(143) = (80)/(13)

**∴ Required time = (80)/(13) hours.**
